name: freight-stations-rats-fork
title: Freight Stations (rat's fork)
author: Ragingart (fork maintained by rat)
description: Fork of Ragingart's Freight Stations with fixes: no rail shift on select-new-contents, no rail placement rule or wagon-slot snapping (stations build anywhere, like vanilla containers), balancer ghosts stranded by flipped pastes are cleaned up instead of stuck forever. Uses the same entity names, so saves migrate over. Do not run alongside the original.
